qa.verdict: This is one of the most playable and immediately usable decks. The Editor Reflex, Consensus Trap, and Genre Inversion create instant creative tension. Nearly every card generates action. Only minor weakness: a few niche cards (Silent Witness, Lonely Smoker). Overall: top-tier creative engine deck.

marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: KREATIVE KAYFAB-KICKS & BOOMERANG BRAIN BOOSTERS – The Expansion Pack for People Who Hate Brainstorming (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

A brainstorm is where a sharp idea goes to get sanded down until nobody hates it and nobody remembers it.

Tzara pulled words out of a hat and called it poetry. Eno printed a deck of provocations to ambush his own studio habits. Jodorowsky handed people symbolic acts to snap them out of a stuck loop. Every one of those started as a sabotage tool, sharp and a little dangerous. Then the workshop industry laminated them, stapled on a feedback form, and sold the whole thing back to you as a team ideation session with good snacks. This deck takes the tools back and peels the lamination off.

This is wrestling pointed at your own creative process. You drop a mechanic onto the Stage, the table has to live with what it does, and a card like THE GHOST SLOT means physically tearing real paper so the hole has to be mentioned in every story that comes after. 52 cut-and-play cards, RAF dice that decide how hard a move lands, and not one facilitator with a flip chart anywhere in the room.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The Kreative Kayfab Core Deck: 52 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" Cards, featuring THE GHOST SLOT, THE JODOROWSKY FIX, and THE WORKED SHOOT, where you break character, say one true thing about the project, and put the mask back on.
- The Freestyle Rules: the complete Anti-Rulebook. No complicated math, just storytelling, RAF dice-driven chaos, Momentum Tokens for ideas that escalate, and the BLÖDSINN! whistle that lets anyone stop the table and force a rewrite when the logic goes slack.
- The Sabotage Engine: 52 mechanics with teeth instead of suit names. THE 25-WORD REDUCTION cuts your idea to 25 words, then 10, then 3, until only the truth survives. THE OFF-TABLE ROLL throws the die onto the floor and lets the landing decide, because the system cannot always contain its own result. The Rupture and Repair pair runs together: name a contradiction, leave it open, then later connect it so the seam holds stronger than the original.

THE "LIVING DECK" PASS (Free Updates)
By grabbing this deck you aren't buying a frozen PDF. You are wired into the Freestyle pipeline. Every future expansion in this cycle, every new cluster of mechanics, every fresh way to wreck a meeting on purpose, lands in your library as a free update, no second checkout.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I make these for the people who have sat through one too many ideation workshops and watched the most interesting thing said all day get voted into mush by lunch. The good idea was usually the one somebody almost didn't say out loud. This deck is the permission to say it. Broke? Enter "0" and take it. Print it, cut it, run it at the next session until the safe answers stop winning. Want to support the craft? Every euro goes straight into the time I spend drawing the next cards and sharpening the mechanics.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
"Sand an idea smooth and it sits there forever. Throw a sharp one and it comes back around."
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
